scoring_justification: Thermal conductivity is the result of a full GAP training + EMD simulation pipeline that cannot be recomputed in the lightweight checker sandbox. The agent's reported kappa values are compared directly to the paper's reported gold with absolute tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold thermal conductivity values for c-Si and a-Si from the paper's EMD-GAP calculations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'thermal conductivity values of c-Si and a-Si are found to be 121 W/mK and 1.4 W/mK, respectively.'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published values; the check verifies that the agent's reproduction falls within expected toolchain variation.

outputs.description: Thermal conductivity of crystalline silicon (c-Si) and amorphous silicon (a-Si) at room temperature, computed by equilibrium molecular dynamics using trained GAP potentials.

steps.description: Compare agent-reported thermal conductivity for c-Si and a-Si to the paper's gold within absolute tolerances.
